subject: MAP: Align goals & 45-day pilot timeline (Amplify Health)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@amplifyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Align goals & 45-day pilot timeline (Amplify Health)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m starting a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to make the pilot scope, success criteria, and timeline explicit so we can move to a 45-day pilot with clear owners and checkpoints. I’ve attached a simple MAP draft and an evaluation checklist to this thread (AMPLIFY_MAP_v1.pdf, amplify_eval_checklist.xlsx).

High-level proposal (please confirm):
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for clinical triage summaries across a 3k-patient window; achieve >= 92% clinical accuracy on our validation prompts and <200ms 95th percentile latency on production-equivalent queries.
- Pilot length: 45 days (prep + 30 days active ingest + 14 day wrap + quality review)
- Key milestones:
  - Week 0: Kickoff + environment & access
  - Week 1–2: Sample ingestion + baseline eval
  - Week 3–6: Active pilot + weekly quality checkpoints
  - Week 7: Final evaluation & next-steps decision

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm champion and 2–3 stakeholders who will own technical access, clinical validation, and procurement.
2) Confirm whether the 45-day cadence looks good or if you prefer shortening to 30 days.
3) Pick a 30–60 minute kickoff window next week — we have availability Tues/Wed afternoon PT.

Links: MAP draft (Google Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPDraft
(Also attached as PDF.)

If this looks reasonable I’ll lock the MAP, create the calendar invite, and share the eval prompts with your team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0128

Attachment(s): AMPLIFY_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), amplify_eval_checklist.xlsx (eval prompts)

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful and matches what we talked about. I’ll be the executive champion on our side. I’ll pull in the right stakeholders:

- Aisha Gonzalez (Director, Clinical Ops) — clinical validation and acceptance criteria (I didn’t include Aisha in the thread because she’s OOO until Tuesday; I’ll forward after I loop her in)
- procure@amplifyhealth.com — procurement contact for SOW/PO

Comments:

- The 45-day plan is fine; if we can compress the prep work into the first week we’d prefer an earlier start.

Kickoff: I can do Tue Aug 24 at 11:00am PT or Thu Aug 26 at 10:00am PT. Which works for you?

Claire
Claire Donovan

claire@amplifyhealth.com

Thanks for confirming, Claire. A couple of short additions from CS / success perspective that I’d like in the MAP:
- Success metrics (owner: Marissa):
  - Baseline -> pilot delta on summary accuracy (clinical review) — target >= +10% improvement over current heuristic
  - Throughput: sustain 150 qps for batch validation without eviction
  - Engagement: 5 clinical reviewers completing 3 validation rounds each
- Deliverables & owners:
  - Environment access (Samir) — by Day 2
  - Eval prompt handoff (Claire / Aisha) — by Day 3
  - Weekly QA sync (Marissa) — 30 minutes, cadence: weekly

Kickoff availability: I can make Thu Aug 26 at 10:00am PT. If Tue Aug 24 11:00am PT works better for Claire’s team, I can move calendar blocks.

Agenda suggestion (30–45m):
1) Introductions & scope
2) Data & access plan
3) Evaluation prompts and pass/fail criteria
4) Logistics: S3 access, redaction, billing contact
5) Next steps and owners

I’ll prepare the 1-pager agenda and share the calendar invite once we lock time.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
